about_the_game:
The Level 4 Mastery Pack provides the fuel to master any path. With 3 months of Omega time for sustained training speed, 1,000 PLEX for trade and customization, and a Prodigy Bundle featureing 1.25 million Skill Points and two Advanced ‘Boost’ Cerebral Accelerators, this pack ensures you’re ready for any challenge. Includes MCT and Skill Extractors for maximum efficiency. 

Contents: 

  • 3 months Omega 

  • 1,000 PLEX 

  • Prodigy Bundle (1,250,000 SP + 2 Advanced ‘Boost’ Cerebral Accelerators) 

  • 2 Multiple Character Training (MCT) 

  • 2 Skill Extractors 

Single purchase per account.
